name: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain

locations.note: 1984: Snake wakes from a nine-year coma in a hospital on a British base in Cyprus and escapes with the bandaged Ishmael as Quiet and XOF attack.
Venom Snake's first theatre: the Soviet-held hills of northern Kabul, where he rescues Kazuhira Miller.
The second theatre: the Angola–Zaire border region, where Snake hunts Skull Face and Cipher's weapon.
Diamond Dogs' new Mother Base, an offshore platform near the Seychelles, is Snake's home between missions.

routes.name: Venom Snake
routes.note: From the Cyprus hospital to Mother Base and out to the two theatres.
